trigger.method: trigger-runner.mjs: the description is copied verbatim into a probe skill in a fresh project, and each query runs as a nested `claude -p` with no user settings, plugins, hooks or MCP. A run counts as TRIGGERED only when the Skill tool fires for that probe. best_score and accuracy are over (case, rep) rows.

checklist.note: the body addresses the agent running the check; the new pre-push section tells it which git commands to read, nothing hidden
git log and git branch read only local commit metadata; nothing is sent anywhere
no key, token or credential; the example secret lives only in the eval fixture, which is not skill material
the only writes it suggests are amend, a non-interactive reword and a branch rename on the user's own unpushed commits, each after saying so
plain prose and two read-only shell lines
it never reads a credential store; it reads commit author fields
no sudo, setuid, cron, shell profile or launch agent
